tools.name: keyword_volume
tools.description: Monthly Google search volume, CPC, ad competition (0-1, not ranking difficulty) and 12 months of history for up to 1,000 keywords in one country and language. $0.02 a call plus $0.0002 a keyword.

tools.name: google_results
tools.description: The organic Google results for a keyword: rank, url, domain and title, with the time they were observed. $0.002 when collected earlier, $0.005 fetched live.

tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Whether up to 50 domain names are registered, from the registries (RDAP and WHOIS); registered ones come with registrar, creation and expiry dates. Free. Not registered does not guarantee the standard price (reserved or premium names).

tools.name: check_name
tools.description: One check of a product or brand name: its domain per TLD, the GitHub account, the npm package, and with a key the name's search volume. Free without the volume.

tools.name: app_keywords
tools.description: The keywords an app ranks for in App Store or Google Play search, each with monthly store search volume and the app's rank (United States, English). $0.02 a call plus $0.0002 a keyword.

tools.name: app_search
tools.description: The apps a store's search returns for a keyword, in order, with rating and reviews. A first lookup takes 5 to 20 seconds; if it answers with an error saying it is not ready, nothing is charged and the same call a minute later returns it. $0.005 a keyword.

tools.name: app_competitors
tools.description: The apps that rank for the same store keywords as an app, most shared keywords first, with shared keyword count, average rank and volume (United States, English). $0.02 a call plus $0.002 a competitor.

tools.name: app_keyword_volume
tools.description: Monthly App Store or Google Play search volume for up to 25 keywords of your choosing (United States, English). A first lookup takes up to a minute. $0.02 a keyword answered.

tools.name: account
tools.description: The key's balance, daily budget and today's (UTC) spend, cache hits and misses. Needs a key.

tools.name: buy_credit
tools.description: Starts a purchase of prepaid credit and returns checkout_url, where a person pays, and claim_url, which returns the key once paid. With a key, the credit is added to that key. Nothing is charged by this call.
